paite: Ka mite aw, ka dan thu ah bil na doh unla; ka kam a thute ah na bil uh hon doh un.
heading: Asaph phatna La / Pathian Leh Amite

paite: Gentehna thu in ka kam ka ding a; nidanglai a thugil gente ka genkhe ding.
Huaite i bil un i za ua, i lungsim in leng i thei uhi, apipute'n leng ahon hilh uhi.
Huaite atate uh lak ah i iim kei ding ua, khang hong om ding kiang ah TOUPA phatna thu leh, ahatdan leh athillamdang pipi hihdante i hilh zaw ding uhi.
Jakobte lak a thu theihsak ahihkip a, Israelte lak ah dan asep a, huaite i pipute kiang ah thupiak in apia a, amau huai thu atate uh kiang ah atheihsak ding un.
Khang hong om ding naupang hong piang dingte'n, atheihna ding un, huaite athou ua, atate uh kiang a, ahilhsawn zel ding un;
Alametna uh Pathian ah akoih ua, Pathian thilhihtet amangngilhlouhna ding leh athupiakte azonna ding un.
Apipute bang ua, suan genhak leh helhat suan lungtang bawldiklou, Pathian lak a lungsim ginom lou pu a a-omlouhna ding un.
Ephraim suante galthuam a kithuam a, thalpeu tawi in, kisual ni in ataikek ua.
Pathian thukhun azui kei ua, adan a om leng a-ut kei ua.
Athilhihte amangngilh ua, athillamdang amuhsakte toh.
Apipute uh mitmuh ah thillamdang pipite ahih zel a. Aigupta gam a Zoan mun ah.
Tuipi akhenhok a, amau agalkaisak a; tuite thil koihkhawm venvon bang in akhawlsak meuhmouh hi.
Sun chiang in meipi in api a, zankhua in meikuang in leng apipi hi.
Gamdai ah suangpite akitamsak a, tui thukpi a kipan bang mai in dawn ding tampi apia hi.
Suangpi a kipan in luite apawtsak a, tuite luipi bang in aluangkhesak hi.
Huchi pipi in leng atung ah thil ahihkhial lailai ua, gamkeu ah Tungnungpen tung ah ahel uhi.
Agongthak uh hihdamna ding a anek ding uh ngen in alungtang un Pathian aze-et uhi.
Ahi, Pathian kalh in thu agen ua; Gamdai ah Pathian in dohkan abawlkhol thei diam maw?
Ngai in, suangpi asat a, tuite ahong kikhohkhia a, luite apiau ah adimlet a; an leng ape thei lai diam maw? Amite a ding in sa abawlkhol diam maw? achi ua.
Huchi in TOUPA'N ana za a, ahehta hi. Jakobte tung ah mei ahong kuangkheta a, Israelte tung ah ahehna ahong suakta hi;
Pathian agingta kei ua, ahotdamna leng amuan louh ziak un.
Himahleh tunglam vandumte thu apia a, van kongkhakte ahonsak a;
anek ding un atung uah manna azusak a, van buh akiang uah apia hi.
Mihingte'n angel an ane ua; vahna khop in an ahon pia hi.
Suahlam huih van ah anungsak a, athilhihtheihna in sim huih anungsak hi.
Atung uah leivui bang in sa azusak a, vasa kha nei tuipi a piaunel zah;
agiahna muntak uah akesak a, a-omna buk kim uah.
Huchi in ane ua, avah ngial ua; alunggulh uh akiang uah apia hi.
Agongthakna uh adai nai kei a, a-an uh akam uah a-om lai a,
Huchi in Pathian hehna atung uah atung a, amihoihte uh athat a, Israel tangval telte asatpuk helhul hi.
Huchipi in leng thil ahihkhial lailai ua, thillamdang hihte agingta tuan kei uh,
Huaiziak in adamsung nite uh bangmah lou phet in ahihmangsak a, adamsung kumte uh launa in ahihmansak lai hi.
Amaute athah chiang in amah azong ua; akik nawn ua, phalvak in Pathian azong uhi.
Pathian asuangpi uh ahi chih leh Pathian Tungnungpen atanpa uh ahi chih atheikhe zel uhi.
Himahleh akam un amaitangphat ua, alei un akiang ah zuauthu agen uhi.
Alungtang uh amah lam ah adik kei a, thukhun ah lah aginom sam kei uh.
Himahleh, amah bel lainatna a dim ahih ziak in athulimlouhna uh angaidam a, amau ahihmang kei hi. Ahi, tamveipi ahehna alakik a, athangpaihnate atokthou nuam kei hi.
Sa leltak ahih uh atheigige a; huih, kik nawn lou ding a nung zel bang in.
Gamdai ah atung ah hel mun in, gamkeu ah amah hih lungkham mun hi na tel uh e!
Akiheikik nawn un Pathian a ze-et ua, Israelte Mi Siangthou ahihvui uhi.
Akhut atheigige kei ua, melma lak a ahumbit ni atheigige sam kei uhi.
Huchi a Aigupta gam ah achiamtehnate akoih a, Zoan loubuk ah athillamdang hihte leng akoih a;
aluipi uh sisan asuaksak a, aluite uh leng sisan asuaksak hi, huchi in adawn theita kei uhi.
Alak uah thou tampi asawl a, huai in amau ane khin a; ukengte leng asawl a, huai in amau ahihmangta hi.
Athilpoute uh leng lung kiang ah apia a, asepgim gah uh khaupe kiang ah apia hi.
Agrep guite uh gial in ahihsia a, atheipi kungte uh leng vuk in ahihsia hi.
Agantate uh gialpi kiang ah apia a, aganhonte uh kek sa velvol kiang ah apia hi.
Ahehna thupitak atung uah akhia a, thangpaihnate, lung hihlouhna mahmahte, mangbatnate, angel giloute,
ahehna a ding in lampi abawlsak a; ahinna uh sihna lak ah ahumbit kei a, ahinna uh hipi kiang ah ape zawta hi.
Aigupta gam a ta masa tengteng athat a, Ham puanin ah ahatna gah masapente.
Himahleh belam bang in amite apikhia a, ganhon bang in gamdai ah api hi.
Bittak in api a, huchi in bangmah alau kei ua; himahleh tuipi in amelmate uh akhuh khinta hi.
Amun siangthou gamgi apitung a, hiai tang, akhut taklam a alei.
Ama uah namte adelhkhia ua, amau khuate gouluah ding in ahawm a, apuaninte uah Israel namte a-omsak hi.
Himahleh, Pathian Tungnungpen aze-et ua, atung ah ahel ua, athu theihsakte azui kei uh.
Kihei nawn in, apipute uh bang in lepchiahtak in agamta zawta ua, thalpeu muanhuai lou bang in apaikawi uhi.
Amun sangte un amah ahihheh ngal a, amilim siamte un amullitsak hi.
Pathian in huai ana zak in aheh a, Israelte akih mahmah hi.
Huchi in Shiloh biakbuk mihing lak a apuanin koih, apaisan a;
ahatna sal ah amansak a, athupina melma khut ah amansak hi.
Amite namsau kiang ah apia a; agouluah ding tung ah ahehta hi.
Mei in atangvalte uh akangmang a, anungakte un kitenna aneita kei uhi.
Asiampute uh namsau a hihpuk in a-om ua; ameithaite un suunna abawl kei uhi.
Huchih lai in, mi ihmu khanglou bang in TOUPA akhanglouta a, mihat uain ziak a kikou bang in.
Amelmate asatkik a, tangtawn minsiatna alohsakta hi.
Huai lou leng Joseph puanin adeih kei a, Ephraim nam leng atelta kei hi;
Judah nam atel zawta a, a-it Zion tang mah.
A-inn siangthou van sangte bang in alam a, tangtawn ding a ahihkip leilung bang in.
Asikha David atel a, belam huang a kipante alakhia a;
Belampu nou kaite zuihna a kipan in apikhia a, ami Jakobte leh agouluah ding Israelte vak ding in.
Huchi in ama'n alungtang uh hoihna bang zel in amaute avak a; akhutsiamna in apita hi.
